description: Beginning of a letter in Arabic. The sender states he fulfilled the addressee's order and shipped something: امتثلت ما امر به مولي الشيخ الجليل ادام الله عزة وحملت . . . Reused on recto for Genesis 12:7, followed by exegesis. (Information in part from CUDL)
